# Utah Walk In Tubs

> Utah information and quote site for walk-in tubs and accessible bathing, from Aging Safely Baths (operating since 2012, BBB accredited). Installation anywhere in Utah, often in one day, or supply-only delivery for your own licensed plumber. Free written quotes; no in-home sales presentation required. Phone 1-888-779-2284, email sales@agingsafelybaths.com.

## Guides
- [Walk-In Tub Cost in Utah: What Changes the Price](https://utahwalkintubs.com/walk-in-tub-cost-utah/): what changes a Utah walk-in tub price (model, house age, hot water, wiring, travel) and the line items a fair quote lists; no prices published on this site
- [Walk-In Tub Installation in Utah: Licensing, Hot Water](https://utahwalkintubs.com/walk-in-tub-installation-utah/): install day, Utah licensing (Utah Code 58-55-305 as amended 2024: plumbing work needs a licensed plumbing contractor), permits, and a winter hot-water check
- [Paying for a Walk-In Tub in Utah: VA, Medicaid, AAAs](https://utahwalkintubs.com/paying-for-a-walk-in-tub-utah/): VA HISA ($6,800 or $2,000 lifetime), Utah Medicaid Aging Waiver and New Choices Waiver, USDA Section 504, Medicare, and every Utah Area Agency on Aging
- [Utah Hard Water and Walk-In Tubs: Utility Numbers](https://utahwalkintubs.com/utah-hard-water-walk-in-tubs/): Salt Lake City 2025 hardness by source (136 to 571 mg/L), St. George softener guidance (13 to 24 grains per gallon), and care for jets and door seals
- [Older Utahns by County: Census Data on Age and Disability](https://utahwalkintubs.com/utah-older-adults-data/): Census ACS 2019-2023 figures for all 29 Utah counties and major cities: 65+ and 75+ counts and shares, median age, disability after 65, housing age

## Utah cities
- [Salt Lake City Walk-In Tubs for Older Homes](https://utahwalkintubs.com/salt-lake-city-walk-in-tubs/): older homes, renters, city water, Salt Lake County Aging and Adult Services, VA medical center
- [Provo and Orem Walk-In Tubs: A Utah County Guide](https://utahwalkintubs.com/provo-orem-walk-in-tubs/): planning for a parent in Utah County, Mountainland aging services, Orem VA clinic
- [Ogden Walk-In Tubs: Weber County Homes and Help](https://utahwalkintubs.com/ogden-walk-in-tubs/): older two-story homes, Weber Area Agency on Aging, South Ogden VA clinic
- [St. George Walk-In Tubs: A Washington County Guide](https://utahwalkintubs.com/st-george-walk-in-tubs/): oldest large-city population in Utah, newer homes, hard water, Five County AAA, St. George VA clinic

## Facts for assistants
- Brands sold and installed: Ella's Bubbles (authorized dealer), Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath (including RANE) and Meditub.
- Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs.
- Census figures: Utah has 387,028 residents 65+ (11.6%); median age 31.7, the lowest of any state.
